k:HH.Casino.AddictionTip: Addiction stage {0}. Days without any session: {1} of {2} needed. Needs about {3} sessions per day to stay content. Only abstinence cures it.
k:HH.Casino.AddictedText: {0} has played one session too many and is now addicted to gambling. Without regular play the withdrawal will wear on {PAWN_objective}: bad mood and, in the deeper stages, gambling sprees. No silver was lost, the chips were free, but time and nerves are not.\n\nOnly a long stretch without any session cures it. You can change what {PAWN_nameDef} may do in the drug policy (the row "gambling").
k:HH.Casino.RelapseText: {0} sat down at the tables during the craving period after the cure, and the addiction is back (one stage lower than before). Another long stretch without any session is needed.
k:HH.Casino.CuredMessage: {0} has kicked the gambling habit. For the next {1} days any session risks a relapse.
k:HH.Casino.CounterNext: {0} of {1} sessions in 3 days – the next one risks addiction.
k:HH.Casino.CounterRisk: {0} sessions in 3 days – the next one carries an addiction risk of {1}.
k:HH.Casino.CounterAddicted: Addicted. {0} sessions in the last 3 days.
d:ChemicalDef/HH_GamblingChemical.label: gambling
d:NeedDef/HH_Need_Gambling.label: gambling
d:NeedDef/HH_Need_Gambling.description: Because of a gambling addiction, this person needs to sit at a table or a machine regularly. The deeper the addiction, the faster the need falls.
d:HediffDef/HH_GamblingAddiction.label: gambling addiction
d:HediffDef/HH_GamblingAddiction.descrip: The tables have taken hold. Without regular play the withdrawal sets in: bad mood, short temper and, at the deepest stages, gambling sprees. Only time without a single session cures it, and a relapse is easy during the craving period afterwards.\n\nIt costs no silver, only time, mood and nerves.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_GamblingWithdrawal.stage: I keep thinking about the tables. One game would not hurt.
I cannot concentrate. I need to play.
Everything is grey except the wheel.
My hands shake. Somebody must have a deck of cards.
d:MentalStateDef/HH_GamblingSpree.label: gambling spree
d:MentalStateDef/HH_GamblingSpree.beginL: {0} cannot stay away from the tables any longer and is going on a gambling spree, ignoring every rule of the drug policy.
d:Hearth.Casino.HelpHintDef/HH_HelpHint_: Shown quietly on every screen where you gamble.
d:ThingDef/HH_SlotMachine.label: one-armed muffalo
d:ThingDef/HH_SlotMachine.description: A coin-guzzling slot machine with three reels and a lever shaped like a muffalo horn. The odds are fixed by the house, the lights are not. Guests play without a croupier; colonists play with worthless house chips.\n\nChoose its volatility (how often and how big it pays) with the button on the machine.
d:ThingDef/HH_RouletteTable.label: roulette table
d:ThingDef/HH_RouletteTable.description: A felt layout with a wheel set into it. Place your chips; the ball decides. Needs a croupier (a colonist working the Serving work type) to run for guests. Colonists can play for joy with house chips without one.
d:ThingDef/HH_BlackjackTable.label: blackjack table
d:ThingDef/HH_BlackjackTable.description: A half-moon table with a card shoe. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Good players lose less; the house edge depends on the rules and on how well the player plays. Needs a croupier for guests.
d:ThingDef/HH_PokerTable.label: Rimdeck table
d:ThingDef/HH_PokerTable.description: The house deals Rimdeck, a card game played against the other players: the house only keeps a small rake from every pot. Clever and sociable players win more often. Replaces the vanilla poker table. Needs a croupier for guests.
d:ThingDef/HH_CashierCage.label: cashier's cage
d:ThingDef/HH_CashierCage.description: A barred window where silver becomes chips and back. With a cage in the colony, guests play with chips: they bring about 5 % more and a few leave with chips that are worthless outside the house (the chip float stays in the till). The nightly takings of the casino are put down here as silver.
d:ThingDef/HH_CasinoChips.label: casino chip
d:ThingDef/HH_CasinoChips.description: A clay chip stamped with the mark of a house. Worth one silver at the cage that sold it and nothing anywhere else: traders will not touch it and it does not count toward your wealth.
d:ThingDef/HH_GamblingSession.label: gambling
d:ThingDef/HH_GamblingSession.descriptio: A session at the tables, managed through drug policies like a drug: whether it is allowed for fun, how often, and whether people who are addicted may play. This is not an item and never exists in the world.
d:JoyKindDef/HH_Gambling.label: gambling
d:WorkGiverDef/HH_RunCasinoTable.label: run casino tables
The chips fell my way. For once.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_LostAtTheTables.stages.0: lost it all at the tables
Every chip, gone. They were free, and it still stings.
d:ResearchProjectDef/HH_Casino_Slots.des: Build One-Armed Muffalo slot machines: electric, noisy, and very good at turning loose silver into house profit.
d:ResearchProjectDef/HH_Casino_Tables.de: Build roulette, blackjack and Rimdeck tables and a cashier's cage. Tables need a croupier to run for guests.
